newsitem.title: USA: ComEd Byron 2 Ill. nuke resumes full power.
newsitem.headline: ComEd Byron 2 Ill. nuke resumes full power.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison's 1,105 megawatt (MW) Byron 2 nuclear unit has resumed full power after restarting late last week, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Monday in its plant status report.
The unit was shut March 15 for maintenance.
The adjacent unit, with an identical generating capacity, was operating at full power, the NRC plant status report stated. Both units are located in Byron, Ill.
Also, ComEd's 794 MW Dresden 2 unit was operating at 81 percent power and expected to decrease to about 70 percent to inspect a leak on a feedwater heater, the report also stated.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
